rationale: X independently surfaces both the confirmed varlen_func-None crash (RuixiangMa's actual finding, albeit mirrored to the masked path) and the swallowed-exception version-cascade issue that echoes the reviewers' version=1/2 confusion and the CI false-pass concern, giving it much better recall of the real ground-truth concerns.
